schema.id: Stable fixture id, family letter + two digits (A01…A38, B01…E05).
schema.title: Short name.
schema.why_breaks: Why the current content script / surroundContents / flatten / mouseup path loses.
schema.html: Compact snippet (no interstitial whitespace between blocks) assigned onto the load target.
schema.selection: null for restore-only rows, else {api:'range', pathFrom:'container', start:{path,offset}, end:{path,offset}, quote}. path is childNode indices AFTER html parse. Offsets are UTF-16 code units.
schema.record: null, or a HighlightRecord subset {id,quote,prefix,suffix,color}. Some rows use extra.records for multi-restore.
schema.ops: Ordered harness steps (load, select, paint, flatten, flattenOnce, restore, restoreStale, mouseup, …).
schema.expect: {paint, exceptionName, markCount, toolbar, restore, wrongSpan, ghostRecord, notes}
schema.oracle: {kind, checks[]} — how to assert without a fuzzy matcher.
schema.browserOnly: true → skip jsdom; run under Playwright Chromium.
schema.extra: Optional parserRecovery, records, mutation, harnessNotes, quoteNotes.
schema.schemaVersion: 2 = machine fields plus founder-facing story / selectHow / selectionAnnotated / expectHuman / repro.
schema.story: 2–3 sentences: what is on the page and what the user (or restore) tries to do.
schema.selectHow: Plain language of the drag, or “no mouse; restore looks for …” on restore-only rows.
schema.selectionAnnotated: Short HTML/text snippet of the relevant region. ⟦ = mouse-down (selection start), ⟧ = mouse-up (selection end). Restore-only rows mark the targeted quote with ‹ › and say “no mouse”. Markers are documentation only — never put them in html.
schema.expectHuman: Plain-language expected failure (e.g. surroundContents throws / paintRange returns null; no mark).
schema.repro: Three short steps to reproduce in DevTools or mentally.

ok: Most A_reject via wrap paintRange (Step 2 harness: mark-breakage-a-reject-paint.test.ts).
C_parser_x recovery via innerHTML (parse5 ≈ HTML parser for these cases).
skip: SVG/MathML range endpoints (A31, A32, C14, C15)

ok: E_* mouseup product path against the real closest() + toolbar
notes: Do not load the unpacked extension and do not boot WXT for this pack.
Drive exported paintRange / resolveAndPaint / flattenText, or dispatch mouseup on a fixture document.
Re-read container.innerHTML (and childNodes) before applying paths on C_parser_x.
A fuzzy / repair harness is deferred — do not implement it in the same PR as this pack.
